body: Suresh, here is a draft for the corporate bulk thali: 5-person pack @ ₹699 (₹140/pax, saving ₹15 vs individual). Includes 2 extra filter coffee cups and a side of papad. You can launch this as a 'Corporate Lunch Pack' for Indiranagar offices. Shall I set this up as a new offer on your profile?
rationale: Responds to the merchant's request for a concrete plan by providing a specific pricing structure (₹699 for 5) derived from the existing ₹149 thali price, adding value (coffee/papad) to justify the bulk rate, and asking for confirmation to implement it.

body: Padma, here is the draft for your Mylapore kids yoga summer camp: 4-week program, 3 classes/week, ages 7-12, priced at ₹2,499. This fits your boutique segment and leverages the strong instructor quality reviews you are getting. Shall I finalize the GBP post and Insta carousel for you?
rationale: Used the merchant's specific intent (kids yoga) and recent conversation context to provide a concrete, ready-to-use plan (pricing, duration, age group) grounded in the merchant's boutique segment and positive review themes. The CTA asks for confirmation to proceed with the marketing assets, externalizing the effort of drafting them.

body: Hi Aditya, this is Karim from Karim's Salon. We have you booked for a visit tomorrow. Please let us know if that works for you.

body: Hi Riya, yeh reminder hai aapke kal ke appointment ke liye. Kya aapka time confirm hai? Reply YES to confirm ya NO to reschedule.
